text.p: Applied Power Inc said Monday it completed the acquisition of C Fab Group Ltd for $13 million in cash plus future consideration based on performance.
Funding for the transaction was obtained through existing debt facilities.
Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, C Fab makes electronic enclosures used by the computer, telecom, datacom and other industries.
With annualized sales of approximately $18 million, C Fab will be integrated with Applied Power's Technical Environments and Enclosures business segment.
C Fab operates two facilities in Dublin.

"The acquisition of C Fab fits our broader TEE business strategy," Philip Burkhart, president of the technical environments segment, said. "We feel the Ireland facilities offer us vital manufacturing and design capabilities to support our expansion efforts throughout Europe."
